evidence_excerpts: The taxonomy table lists input data types such as image/video, volume data, geometric meshes, point cloud, hologram data, and light field; it also lists foveation principles and rendering paradigms including multi-spatial resolution, LoD, rasterization, ray tracing, ray casting, neural rendering, phase retrieval, and data transmission.
text: Foveated rendering methods span multiple data types, foveation principles, and rendering paradigms, including image/video, volume data, meshes, point clouds, holograms, light fields, multi-resolution variants, LoD, rasterization, ray tracing, ray casting, neural rendering, phase retrieval, and data transmission.
